plan.scene: Elevated view from balcony/rooftop over a flooded Himalayan hillside market street during heavy monsoon rain and overcast misty weather. Muddy brown torrent inundates road and ground floors. Foreground: small single-storey roadside shops with corrugated metal roofs and closed roller shutters, one with green fascia signboard, being undercut and washed away by floodwater across sequence. Street is wet gravel/asphalt with scattered paper trash. People sheltering: one person with green patterned umbrella standing in street, later group of onlookers with blue, green, purple, black umbrellas watching swollen river. Vehicles/objects: motorcycle/scooter covered with black cover parked near street-food pushcart with blue canopy and yellow signboard. Background: dense multi-storey concrete/brick hillside houses 2-4 floors with flat/sloped metal roofs in pink, green, white, shops and homes built on slope, large green trees, misty forested hills. No clear emergency vehicles. Mood is monsoon flash flood in small north Indian hill town.
